Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates patchy, ill-defined opacities in the right lower lung zone (right basal shadowing), which is characteristic of bronchopneumonia. In patients with Duchenne muscular dystrophy, respiratory muscle weakness leads to an ineffective cough and poor secretion clearance, predisposing them to aspiration and recurrent lower respiratory tract infections like bronchopneumonia, which explains the dyspnea and non-productive cough.
